goal: Require end-to-end validation of the exact public job-detail URL and the actual application transition Bora would use before serious-role promotion or package generation.
acceptance_conditions: the exact public job-detail URL Bora would open must itself establish the current exact role and must not be a dead/error/generic-search state

the application transition reached from that exact public job-detail page must be exercised or otherwise directly resolved to the actual current end-user application destination before actionability PASS
an Apply-looking control, ATS API record, embedded metadata, search/index result, or requisition token cannot substitute for successful end-user transition validation
any explicit dead/error page, generic careers/search redirect, lost role/requisition identity, or unusable application transition vetoes actionability
package-time recheck must repeat the same end-user route validation; prior pursuit-time success alone is insufficient

the rule does not blacklist Workday or any ATS vendor and does not alter Qualification Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, recency, start horizon, employer exclusion, immigration, resume, or cover-letter doctrine
fresh chats inherit the requirement through always-on role-selection/resume rules and AGENTS.md
stop_conditions: implementation requires runtime/browser automation code or schema changes
implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths
implementation weakens the existing semantic quorum or explicit dead/error veto
implementation changes qualification, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, immigration, recency, start-horizon, employer-exclusion, resume-content, or cover-letter-content doctrine
